integrity: Proved by exact minimum-coordinate slicing, integral finite differences and asymptotic algebra; 15 finite exact Ehrhart checks are corroborating evidence, not an infinite proof. Earlier k=1 and k=n formulas acknowledged as previously known. Originality may be limited by unindexed equivalent literature.
scientific_limitations: Real finite pointed metrics with leaf distances one and exactly 2..n-1 equal shortened hub spokes, radius t in [1/2,1]. Anchored coordinate volume of dual Lipschitz unit ball only; not primal volume, Mahler product, unequal weights or arbitrary finite metrics.
title: Exact volume, strict diminishing losses, and a boundary layer for partially shortened star metrics
